header_sentences: See Voice; and see Expression, and Speak.

contexts.text: Whatever word in the Word does not involve the Lord, is not Divine.
There is not the least of a word which is not representative...
Every word, etc. of an Angelic Spirit is alive. (Explained.)
The Angels do not know even the proximate meaning of a single word (of the letter)... They have only the idea of the Things signified by the words and names.

He who fixes his attention on the sense of the words, hears the words, but as it were does not hear them... but he who attends to the words (only) apprehends little of the sense... and sometimes forms a judgment of all that is said from a single word, or grammatical form.
The Most Ancients did not speak so much by words...
With external respiration came the speech of words, that is, of articulate sounds, into which were determined the ideas of thought.
In the Word, one word is never used instead of another.
Every word in the Word is from the Lord. Explained.

They who are in the internal sense can know... from a single word what is the subject treated of... When a different subject is treated of, the words are at once different, or the same words stand in a different connection. The reason is that there are words peculiar to spiritual things, and words peculiar to celestial things... Example(s)... In the Hebrew they are very often distinguishable by the sound, Explained.
Therefore such mild words are here used.
Not like the speech of words, of our time... AC 1120.
Than by articulate sounds, or sonorous words...
There is nothing in any word that is not directed by applications of the breathing.
The quality of Spirits known from every word. Explained. AC 1640:2. SE 3064, Explained.
Spirits can represent more by one idea than they can utter by a thousand words.
The language of Spirits is not of words... When with man, their ideas pass into the words that are in the man; and... they suppose the words to be their own.

The words they speak... are well chosen and clear, full of meaning, and distinctly pronounced... They choose the words better and more promptly than the man himself... for the ideas of their language inflow only into words that are fitting; almost as when a man speaks, and thinks nothing about the words... for then the thought falls readily and spontaneously into the words: it is the internal meaning that brings forth the words.
The speech of words is that proper to man, in fact to his corporeal memory.
Every word contains an idea of great possible extension...
Ideas the primitives of words.
In choirs they have no thought about the words, or ideas... The words follow spontaneously from the meaning.
The series... cannot appear when each thing is explained according to the signification of the words... As with one who hears another... and pays attention to the words.
The most ancient mode of writing represented subjects... by words that were understood quite differently.
The speech of Spirits among themselves is effected by ideas, the originaries of words. AC 1876, Explained.
The speech of celestial Spirits cannot easily inflow into the articulate sounds, or words, with man; for it cannot be fitted to a word in which there is anything that sounds harshly...
Others spoke by a belching of words, as from the belly.
Each of the words (in the Word) presents in form its own idea; for a word is nothing but an idea so presented in form that the sense may be perceived.
The Word is inspired, not only as to each word, but as to the letters...
No part of a word of the Word can [lass to Spirits...
How the speaking (of the Word) came to man by words of articulate sound. Explained.
There are inexhaustible things in every word of the Word...
Angelic ideas do not fall into the words, but only into the sense of the words...
They who perceive the Word as to the affection, pay no attention to the words...
Souls speak together most distinctly, yet without the speech of words.
(The internal sense is here) not so evident from the signification of the words...
Angelic speech, not distinct in words.
All the words have a spiritual sense.
The internal sense does not come into view, unless the words are explained one by one according to their constant signification.
The series cannot appear fully in the explanation of the several words...
The ideas belong to the Angels and Spirits, the words into which they inflow, to the man.
Men cannot speak together except by languages distinguished into articulate sounds, that is, into words... because (they speak) from the exterior memory.
These are Divine things which can be expressed by no forms or formulae of words.

When (speech that is heard) ascends towards the interiors, it passes into ideas not unlike those of sight, and from these into intellectual ideas, and thus becomes a perception of the sense of the words.
The ideas (of the interior Heaven) are not expressible in words...
Why this has been explained for the most part only as to the signification of the words...
There are words in the Word that express spiritual things, and words that express celestial things, and this constantly. Example(s).
All human words... as they involve natural things, are inadequate to express these things.
There is not a single word used in the Word that does not involve a heavenly arcanum.
The Word is inspired as to all the words...
As man's spirit is in the light of Heaven... many things that are interior have fallen into words (that are used correspondentially).
Like one who... takes in the sense, and does not attend to the words. AC 5165:2.
Like one who is intent upon the words...
The speech of Angels is effected by means of spiritual and celestial ideas, which to them are the forms of words...
There is no other way than to use these words; for without words adapted to the subject, nothing can be described.
The things which then appear... do not fall into words; for human words are from ideas formed from things that are in the light of the world.
(Philosophical things) are mostly bare words...
The interior significatives of words originate for the most part from the interior man...
Lowest truths... being in the external memory... can be represented to others by forms of words, that is, by ideas formed into words by means of such things as are of the world and its light.
So far as thought and speech are determined to... words, they become less universal...
(Thus) in so far as the thought regards the words of a speaker, it does not regard his meaning.
The interior mind... does not think from the words of any language...
Those in the other life... understand no human words, but only the sense of the words; and this not according to the man's natural thoughts, but according to his thoughts that are spiritual.
Why one word sometimes means many things.
Man thinks in a moment more than he can utter in half an hour, because he thinks abstractedly from the words of language.
There are words which constantly = good; words which constantly = truth; and words which constantly = both... AC 8314. AC 8330. AC 10254:2. DSS 80:end.

In (spiritual writings) all the words, and even the syllables, involve such things as are of that World, thus spiritual things, and they are perceived from the aspiration, and from the affection that results from their utterance, thus from a milder or a harsher modification.
The thought was then as it were kept in prison; for it was determined solely to the words, by withdrawing the mind from the sense. SE 1950.
So, innumerable things concur to one word, as foldings of the lips, etc.
The Angels can know, from a single word that comes forth from the thought, the quality of a Spirit, or man.

Ideas of thought are the words of Spirits; and ideas of thought still more interior are the words of Angels. Ideas, being the words of speech, are sonorous (there); so that the tacit thought of man is audible to Spirits and Angels, when the Lord so pleases. AC 7745.
(The Spirits of Mercury) are averse to the speech of words, because it is material...
Affectations of elegance... hide Things, and present words, which are the material forms of Things.
In the Word, where truth is expressed by its words, good is also expressed by its words...
It appears as if the words of speech were in the thought, but it is a fallacy...
When the speech of the spirit inflows into the correspondent organs of the body, it presents the speech of words...
Yet, the words of spiritual speech are not such words as man uses in the body, but are ideas...
For spiritual speech is not one of material words, but of spiritual words, which are ideas modified into words in the spiritual aura...
The speech (of the Angels of Jupiter) was not effected (with me) by words, but by ideas... So do they speak with the men of their Earth, Explained.

The Most Ancients could not have the speech of words, because the words of language were not poured in immediately, but had to be invented and applied to Things, which could not be done except in course of time.
The dissidence is clearly perceived in every word, and in the tone of every word...
In the Word there are words that belong to the spiritual class, and words that belong to the celestial class... There are also words that are predicated of both (truth and good).
The spiritual signification is seen in the very word walk, as in many others.
Truth Divine in the fifth degree is such as is in the First Heaven... and is such that a great part of it cannot be uttered in human words.
In order to know the thought (of the spiritual) it must be collected from their words; but with the celestial it is not so...
For the interior sense of very many words has flowed from the Spiritual World from correspondences. Example(s).
When let down again into the light of the natural man, I could not express in words the things I had heard...
For words adapt themselves to their subject...
The initiaments of the thoughts are devoid of words of speech...
The quasi articulate speech (in the Fourth Earth) is not by words, but by ideas...
The speech of words is relatively material.
There is an internal sense... not only as to the sense of many words, but also as to every word.
Angelic speech is equally distinguished into words as is human speech... and the Angels utter their words by means of the respiration...
The articulations of sound, which are words, correspond (there) to the ideas of thought...
The angelic language has nothing in common with human languages, except some words, which sound from some affection; yet not with the words themselves, but with their sound.
The Angels cannot utter one word of human language; it has been tried...
(The Angels) can express by one word what man cannot by a thousand words.
The ideas of thought of the Angels, from which are their words, are modifications of the light of Heaven; and the affections, from which is the sound of the words, are variations of its heat...
By a few words, the Angels can present what has been written on many pages.
The ideas of thought of the Angels, and the words of their speech, thus make a one... and this is why every word comprehends in it so many things.

From the words of the Word in the Hebrew, it may in some measure be known whether they belong to the celestial or the spiritual class... those which involve good partake much of u and o, and somewhat of a; and those which involve truth, of e and i... In human discourse also, when great subjects are treated of... those words are preferred that contain the vowels u and o.
(In the writings in Heaven) the hand does not hesitate in the choice of any word, because the words they speak, as well as those they write, correspond to the ideas of their thought...

The quality of the wisdom of the Angels cannot be described in words... The Angels can express in one word what a man cannot in a thousand words; moreover in one angelic word there are innumerable things that cannot be expressed in the words of human language... What the Angels do not fully express by the words of their speech, they supply in the tone... They can utter in a few words all the things written in a volume... and insert into every word such things as elevate to interior wisdom; for... every word is consonant to their ideas; and the words are varied in infinite modes according to the series of the Things...
The interior Angels are able to know the entire life of a speaker from the tone and some words...
I can describe the peace of Heaven, but not in words, such as it is in itself, because human words are not adequate, but only in words such as it is comparatively...
A speaker who draws attention more to his words than to the meaning of his words, affects the hearing of another more than his mind.
No word can be wanting without the series of Things in the internal sense suffering a consequent change.
That it is from the spiritual sense that the Word is... holy in every word. Explained.

From the sound the Angels know a man's love, from the articulation of the sound, his wisdom, and from the sense of the words, his knowledge. They say that these three are in every word, because a word is as a conclusion; for the sound, the articulation, and the sense are in it... From every word of one who is speaking in a series, the celestial Angels perceive the general state of his lower mind, and some of the particular states also. (What there is in every word of the Word. Explained.)
This is why it is said... that a man shall render an account of his words. SE 2661.
There was no word of spiritual speech that was like any word of natural speech...

(This) cannot be described otherwise by words flowing from natural ideas; but it can by words flowing from spiritual ideas, because these are apart from space (and which therefore) do not fall into any words of natural language.
Place Salvation in certain words... DP 264:3. DP 279:4.
(The words of spiritual language are not understood by Spirits themselves when the Spirits are with men. Shown.)
The words are Hewing...
The words of speech are all from natural things... but the sense is spiritual.
The celestial love soft words...
If 0116 word is uttered that word is as it were put on (by the Spirits)...
There is a certain universal sphere of the thoughts which rules... so that all the words or ideas flow fitly...
When these (spiritual ideas) inflow into the memory of a man, they excite corresponding words...
Spirits excite the ideas, consequently the words, which are in agreement with their nature.
Spirits speak by ideas the primitives of words; for in every word there is some idea, and in every composition of words, a composite idea...
When (their speech) entered my internal sense, [it fell] into distinct words...
I have spoken with Spirits by ideas only, without words, and they have understood as well as with words...
Particulars are the words of every language...
Nay, the ideas of the words... are material...
He who inheres in words, inheres in material and corporeal things...
On those who inhere solely in the words of the Word...
The Angels can then know how many times I have read these words...
Each word is as it were a vessel...
Nature of the Hebrew words.
They who are high over head perceive the sense without being disturbed by the words.
Fitting words then follow...
That an idea remains attached to a word.
Therefore such words should be constantly used as have had an idea once impressed on them.
For every word has an idea which is of great extension...
That the quality of a man is sometimes Known from a single word. Explained.
Their thought does not fall into words, but into motions of the lips.
Spirits and Angels use familiar words, and no word is introduced that multiplies the sense, or diverts it; (they avoid) an artful elegance and combination of words...
A speech of words (in which attention is paid only) to the sense of the words. Described.
(Such) answer the same purpose as certain words... as connectives.

On the materials of words. - When I took certain words from my collection to insert them in what I was writing, and I took a single word... that was not in my memory, there occurred a change of Spirits... The reason was that Spirits succeeded who indulge in words, or the materials of speech, but the former only in thoughts: thus I learned from experience that these two kinds of Spirits cannot be together...
When Spirits are speaking together, they cannot bring forth... a word of human language. (Continued. See Speak.)
For many of these (ideas) make one idea of speech, or one word.
Examples of the articulate words of spiritual language. SE 6063. SE 6090. LJPost 332. AE 107:end.
Not a single word of the (infernals) can be uttered by the Angels...

The words of the spiritual Angels... have an affinity with the vowels e and i... but the words of the celestial Angels, with a, o, and u... Therefore when a man is speaking with the latter, he is diverted from words that contain e and i, to words that contain a, o, and u.
Hence, in the Hebrew language, and, in general, in the most ancient language, there were words proper to the celestial class, and to the spiritual class; and some common to both.
The words (in the writing of the spiritual Heaven) are according to their natural ideas.

In the Spiritual Kingdom (the writing) is made by words written in a like diction to that (here); but the words there are from their natural or universal language... I have often seen such words in Roman letters, but when I was in the natural sphere I understood nothing whatever of them...
But the writing of the celestial is quite different... They express, by one such (inflected) form, more than can be expressed by very many words in the spiritual language...
The speech of Spirits... is from their interior memory, the ideas from which become words, but such as accord with the Things themselves; which also are the initiaments of natural words.
The celestial do not speak anything from their interior, because this does not fall into words.
The ideas of the speaking thought, with man, are devoid of words...
Every subject has its own conformity... and these conformed ideas fall, with Spirits, into words, which are distinctly enunciated, and are distinctly and sonorously heard...
(Thus, spiritual) speech is one of words, but of entirely different words, being formed according to the nature of the Thing [spoken of], and articulated by the sound...
a. How much the words of the language of Spirits differ from the words of that of men. Explained.
I could express even material things without words...
The fourth class... attend solely to the words (of the Word)...
In (that Word) there are words which only the wiser (Angels) understand...
(Thus) the writings in Heaven (contain) words that contain more than those who read them are aware of...
Not like the inspiration of a prophet, to whom all the several words were dictated.
One letter (there) means an entire word.
How much more perfect are ideas than words of speech. Explained.

The Spirits and Angels were told to speak words... in their spiritual state, and to retain them when with me in a natural state, and then not any word was similar, nor did they understand any of their own words. Example(s).

It was granted to some Angels of the Middle Heaven to speak with some of the Third Heaven, and to retain in the memory what they had said, and afterwards to return into their own Heaven, and they told me that they could not express any idea or any word of the previous state.
I have retained the words (uttered by the Angels) and have afterwards examined to see whether any word coincides with any word... of men, and there has not been one.
The spiritual Angels utter the words of their speech according to correspondences. Example(s).
They have correspondences in the words of their speech which previously they had not known... Their words are all formed from correspondences. Example(s).
